summary.text: Dave McCormick is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 82, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a small business owner who took office on December 1, 2024.

paragraphs.text: David McCormick was born in Morgantown, West Virginia, and earned a bachelor's degree in marketing in 1991 and an MBA in 2001, both from West Virginia University.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner.
McCormick succeeded Debbie Warner in District 82 when he assumed office on December 1, 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
